Name: Ancient Fruit Color Variants - for JsonAssets
Author: Zhell
Description:
Adds new crops: 8 different color variants of Ancient Fruit.
- Black, Green, Orange, Pink, Purple, Red, White, Yellow.

The new crops are completely identical to the basic (blue) Ancient Fruit. It's simply 8 new crops each with a different color on the product and plant.
They can be planted in the same seasons as regular Ancient Fruit, sell for the same amount as regular Ancient Fruit, take the same time to mature, and regrow in 7 days, just like regular Ancient Fruit.

The seeds can be bought at Pierre's during Spring/Summer/Fall, but only after the player has shipped at least 1 regular Ancient Fruit.
